info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Market Data By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Data Management API allows businesses to update specific market data parameters, enhancing their ability to manage dynamic market conditions. This PATCH operation is particularly useful for updating individual aspects of market data configurations identified by param1. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts and trading platforms that require real-time data adjustments to optimize trading strategies. By enabling precise updates, this API supports better decision-making and operational efficiency in financial services.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific Market Data Switch Administration resource identified by its ID. Use this endpoint to modify existing configurations or attributes associated with the specified resource.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to update the market data switch configuration for the specified resource. It must contain the necessary fields to specify which aspects of the market data switch should be modified.
